text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, cisplatin is not on FDA's current shortage list. Our inventory across Corvale East and Corvale General ranges from 12 to 31 days of supply depending on presentation and location.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show cisplatin is not on the shortage list as of 2026-10-21, and the prior shortage first posted on 2023-02-10 has been resolved. The earlier shortage posting followed an FDA inspection at Thymoorgan Pharmazie Gmbh (FEI 3002320821) that ended 2022-10-06 and was classified VAI, 127 days before the 2023-02-10 posting. A later inspection at the same Thymoorgan plant ended 2023-04-25 and was also classified VAI, 74 days after the shortage posting. Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3009056604) has a history of VAI inspections, with the most recent classification letter dated 2019-12-10, 1158 days before the 2023-02-10 posting. The preferred purchasing option is Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose plant was last inspected VAI on 2023-08-24.

Our position: Supply is adequate for current demand. No shortage exists per FDA. We will maintain the preferred supplier and monitor inventory weekly.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue primary purchasing from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — approved by buyer.
2. Qualify Sagent Pharmaceuticals as secondary source — approved by buyer and quality assurance.
3. Qualify WG Critical Care, LLC as tertiary source — approved by buyer and quality assurance.
4. Defer Accord Healthcare Inc. due to Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited OAI classification 2022-12-02 — approved by buyer and quality assurance.
5. Defer Apotex Corp. due to unidentified manufacturing site — approved by buyer and quality assurance.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or clinical protocol changes at this time.
